limitations: No clients, Linux runtime or 50+ player workload.
One capture per final scenario; fixed seed does not eliminate RNG/scheduling and map-population differences.
Fresh before-memory idle control has 331 pipenets; historical idle had 296. Fire/SM before-memory captures are historical.
CPU is percent of one core; private memory includes allocator retention and is not added to working set.
SM comparisons remain diagnostic because baseline/runtime gates are not clean.
Known source runtimes outside atmosphere were not fixed.
Idle private ranges overlap: before 2529.4-2817.1 MiB, after 2535.5-2551.7 MiB. Full peak delta is not a causal COW saving; initial pipenet counts differ 331/296.
